design_bible:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE standalone high-fidelity Android-first phone screen for the existing local party game IMPOSTER. This is a small feature extension of the referenced app, NOT a redesign. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: preserve their app visual language, type, controls and paper-cut artwork, but render the screen content specified below.
LOCKED DESIGN BIBLE: charcoal background #141916, flat dark surface #1C211E, structural border #343D35, warm ivory #F4F1E8, muted sage #B4C8AD, soft vivid lime #D6F56B for primary actions, enabled toggles and selections. Tiny terracotta #D98672 accents only within illustrations/avatars. DM Sans rounded modern grotesk; main headings 30–34 logical px, body 16–18, controls 18–20, supporting text at least 14. 24px page gutters, 16px card/button radius, 60px primary buttons, comfortable 48px touch targets. Flat rows with thin separators, circular initials avatars, simple custom filled paper-cut illustrations with only restrained tactile paper grain. This exact warm, quietly playful palette is mandatory.
PRESENTATION: portrait 1:2 image, one fully visible front-facing slim black Android phone, subtle consistent narrow frame and rounded corners, equal calm outer margins on near-black #0E120F. Match the reference phone scale, normal 390x844 logical viewport. No hands, no environmental props, no text outside the phone, no OS clock/status bar/notifications, no Dynamic Island. Frame is presentation only. UI must fit with comfortable safe areas, no clipped footer or text. Text sharp and verbatim. No bottom navigation tabs, gradients, glow, glass, glossy 3D, emojis, photos, heavy shadows, timers, recording controls or sound meters. Public screens never show a secret word, private hint, or who is the imposter. No settings for picking individual rules; there is one random-rules toggle. All supplied headings and button labels should be reproduced exactly once.

screens.title: Host lobby — random rules enabled
screens.spec:
HOST LOBBY, BEFORE ROUND 3. Four players, same party, session 1 first to 15. Keep existing familiar lobby structure.
Top area: ivory title "Friday night"; small settings cog and logout icon accessible at top right. Sage Wi-Fi line "Hosting · Home Wi-Fi". Small label "4 players · 1 imposter". A quiet compact "Show invitation" text action with QR glyph keeps invitation access present without inventing a fake scannable QR.
Below: flat trophy summary row "Session 1 · First to 15".
Then a new flat tappable row with a small shuffle glyph, title "Random round rules", sage sublabel "Classic, Act It, or Sound Only", lime right-side status "On" and a subtle chevron. This is an entry to session settings, not three individual mode selectors.
Four flat roster rows with initials circles and clean separators: "Alex" plus "You · Host" and lime crown; "Sam" plus "Ready" and sage check; "Mia" plus "Ready" and sage check; "Ben" plus "Ready" and sage check. AL lime, SA sage, MI terracotta, BE sage.
Sticky footer: outline button "Topic settings"; primary lime button "Reveal round rule"; small centered sage line "The rule comes before topic voting." Make settings discoverable and preserve a familiar quiet lobby, no huge illustration.

screens.title: Session settings — enabled before the draw
screens.spec:
HOST SESSION SETTINGS BOTTOM SHEET opened from the lobby, before the next rule draw. The top 18% of phone shows the dimmed existing Friday night lobby with title and a hint of roster; remainder is a tall flat #1C211E sheet with 24px top corners, small drag handle, title "Session settings", close X.
Hero setting is an open row: bold title "Random round rules"; right-aligned lime toggle switched ON, white knob to right; explicit sage state "On". Under it readable description "A surprise rule before every topic vote."
Below, one flat list titled "In the draw". Three rows with small paper-cut glyphs, NO toggles, NO radio buttons, NO checkboxes: speech bubble "Classic" and sublabel "Give a spoken clue."; gesturing hand "Act It" and sublabel "Silent actions. No sounds."; sound wave "Sound Only" and sublabel "Make sounds. No words." Thin quiet separators.
Below list two clear sage lines: "Topics match the drawn rule." and "Changes apply to the next rule draw." Preserve breathing room.
Full-width lime bottom button "Done" closes the immediately applied setting. Small sage footer "Your session keeps going." No scores editable here, no target reset, no confirmation dialog, no mode picker.

screens.title: Public rule reveal — Sound Only
screens.spec:
PUBLIC ROUND RULE REVEAL, HOST VIEW, ROUND 3, before any topic voting and before private cards. Top bar centered "Round 3 · Round rule", small back arrow left and settings cog right. Centered heading "Make some noise." supporting sage "The rule for everyone this round."
Main focal point one large warm ivory paper-textured card, about 300 logical px tall, same physical-card language as app secret cards but clearly public. At top small charcoal label "THIS ROUND". Center custom large paper-cut speaker with 3 sage/charcoal sound arcs and a tiny lime ray; NOT a microphone. Beneath it large bold dark title "Sound Only". Short dark rule copy "No words. No gestures."
Below card readable centered ivory instruction "Make a sound linked to your word." Sage line "Talking is allowed during discussion."
Small muted shuffle line "Chosen at random · Same rule for all".
Sticky full-width lime button "Vote for topic"; underneath small sage "Only sound-ready topics come next."
No actual secret word, no sample animal clues, no role badges, no selectable modes, no reroll, no wheel, no recording. Clearly the TOPIC VOTE is the NEXT step.

screens.spec:

screens.title: Topic ballot — filtered for Sound Only
screens.spec:
PERSONAL TOPIC APPROVAL BALLOT, ROUND 3, after Sound Only was revealed. Match the reference existing topic-voting screen, including its two-column topic grid and selected lime checks. Four-player party Alex, Sam, Mia, Ben. Current player Alex has not submitted and has selected Animals and Music; the other three players submitted.
Top app bar "Round 3 · Topic vote", back left, search right.
Heading "Choose the mood". Immediately underneath a compact open sound-wave line in lime/sage "Sound Only · No words". Supporting sage sentence "Only topics with sound-ready words."
A two-column grid, 3 visible rows. Each card has a small custom filled paper-cut illustration above bold label. Row1 "Animals" with clay paw SELECTED lime border/check, "Music" with sage notes SELECTED lime border/check. Row2 "Nature" sage leaves unselected, "Travel" ivory suitcase unselected. Row3 "Sports" sage ball unselected, "Everyday" ivory mug unselected. Neutral structural borders on unselected tiles. Do not show unsuitable disabled topics, unavailable words, word counts, opt-in badges or topic approval totals. The catalog is filtered; those are six proposed compatible topics, not six secret words.
Below grid four small connected progress dots, three lime filled one sage outline. Text "3 of 4 players voted".
Footer sage "2 topics selected", lime button "Lock my vote", tiny-but-readable sage "Results appear when everyone votes."
Keep the visible rule reminder without overcrowding the existing ballot layout. No secret word or hint.
